title: Build the two-class first loop with supplies, recovery foundations and scale evidence
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Adds a shared offline/Colyseus first loop for Soldier and Medic against Hollow Constable in Gatehouse, with public/private rooms, reconnect, votes, class shops, 378 authored skill nodes, illustrated setup, build grades and later-phase/Brutal attacks. Adds eight usable consumables, bounded capacity admission/cold-start messaging, pooled projectiles and limited north/south walk strips. Protocol 4.

Recovery foundations include server-only signed multiplayer boundaries and a transactional SQL run ledger with idempotent events and owner leases/epochs. They are tested locally with actual SQLite transactions, including competing claims; deployed authenticated D1 recovery and rankings remain unfinished.

Validation: 56 meaningful rules/real-WebSocket/SQL tests, strict TypeScript, 15-locale/content checks and production build. Assistant desktop browser review covers votes, grades, walls, phases, sprites and actual keyboard/pointer supply use. Performance JSONs distinguish historical pooled foreground evidence from current protocol-4 server repeats and throttled-preview limitations. Current local 49+1 server stress holds 4,000 hostiles/fifty active for 90 seconds, p99 19.772 ms/max 37.428 ms. Current preview remained throttled, so current foreground FPS is unestablished. See docs/FIRST_PLAYABLE.md and docs/HOSTING_CAPACITY.md.

Keep draft: full content/action art, current foreground/physical-phone/controller/human evidence, free-host capacity/endurance, live recovery/rankings, Windows/offline/LAN packaging and matching final releases remain open. Other five classes/routes/maps are visibly In production. No full-game or human/native-language approval is claimed.

Progress toward #4 and #5; their acceptance gates remain open. Preserves the original uncommitted work and historical sealed Stage 1 delivery.
